title: Gimme Gimme Gimme - Narada Michael Walden & Patti Austin

I caught your smile and you threw me some heat
Well, I liked your style, it was strong but sweet
I felt for you right then and then
I didn't care who knew I'd follow you anyway

Then your song touched me deep inside
Until you came along, I wasn't satisfied
I fell for you right there and there
I didn't care who knew I'd follow you anywhere
Give it back, give it back
Hey, yeah, yeah
